text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! And then, and then? What did Kris 
S-san say?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
She said, "Perfect!"... Fufu! Getting 
praised after such intense special 
training made it all the more wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My, to get her to say that much! And so 
well deserved!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I feel kind of proud myself♪ Ah... you 
really are cheered on by so many horse 
girls, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know! A Cinderella who worked so 
hard on her dancing deserves a reward! 
Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: —Oh, my! Dresses? How gorgeous...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you have to be prepared so you're 
ready whenever you're invited to a dance 
party♪ Let's try on some dresses!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: —D-Does it suit me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Even better than I imagined! It's 
like a real princess has appeared!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yours is lovely too, Heart-san! Maybe I 
should try that one on as well...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
OMG! That one suits you too. Ah, I just 
can't decide!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it really is hard to choose. You 
shower me with compliments no matter which 
one I wear, Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Sorry! Oh, I know, why don't you 
try a light dance in it?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Good idea! Let's see how easy it is to 
move in.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
.........! How elegant. I feel like you've 
become somehow more mature than before.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Could this be the result of our special 
training? Fufu! Heart-san, may I have this 
hand...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(It's so easy to dance with her... She 
really has improved. Both her technique 
and her expressiveness...)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: Heart-san?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You really are a girl who grows in the 
blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Receiving so much love from all kinds of 
horse girls...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Yes! But every bit of that is all because 
you were there for me, Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Whenever things get tough, I always think, 
"What would Heart-san do?"

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
You are a precious guiding light within 
me. So... um...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say things like that makes me 
truly happy after all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Chuckle... Fufufu! Thank you... Thank you, 
Tact...

That night— The dormitory sunroom was 
unusually lively.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi, everyone! So this is where you were. 
Mind if I join in?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Heart! Perfect timing! We were just 
talking about you!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Tact-san told us. That you two went 
out together after school today.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! She told me all kinds of stories 
about her time with you two as well! Thank 
you for looking after that girl♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No thanks... are needed. I have... high 
expectations for her.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
As do I. I'm looking forward to her 
future. After all, she is such a dedicated 
hard worker.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! I totally get that! Seeing 
how earnest she is just makes you really 
wanna cheer her on!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... how reassuring. To think there are 
so many watching over her...!

One day, while passing by the student 
dorms on an errand, I spotted Daring Heart 
and the others. It looked like they were 
wrapping up and heading back.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Bye~~~~! Fufufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's right, everyone's looking forward 
to it. To where a diamond in the rough 
like you will go... right?
